source: Original schematic based on the fourth-stage social-studies curriculum. Port relationships were verified against Maritime and Port Bureau, MOTC WGS84 lighthouse coordinates: Tamsui Port 25°10.627′N, Keelung 25°9.325′N, Anping 22°59.445′N, and Kaohsiung 22°36.924′N; calibrated against CAP-107-MAIN-INTEGRATED-SOCIAL-051 and official 106-115 map item forms.
transformationRecord: No third-party artwork used; coastline and labels were independently drawn as a non-scale teaching schematic.
caption: 清末臺灣四個通商口岸位置示意
altText: 臺灣輪廓上，北部西側的滬尾略在北部東側的雞籠以北；西南部的安平在打狗以北。
longDescription: 圖上方為北。滬尾位於北部西側，緯度略高於北部東側的雞籠；安平與打狗位於西南部，安平在打狗以北。圖例說明北部主要出口茶與樟腦，南部主要出口糖。地圖僅呈現相對位置，不表示實際距離、精確經緯度或行政疆界。

dataFallback.summary: 清末通商口岸由北到南的相對位置與主要出口商品。
